title: UI shows "Failed to fetch diff: Bad Request" when CURRENT is selected
description: Please fix the back end so that it displays a diff against the current working directory when CURRENT is selected.
notes:
## Current Status

Fixed backend and frontend code for CURRENT option, but frontend needs rebuild.

## Root Cause
When "CURRENT" (working directory) is selected in To dropdown:
1. Git diff correctly returns new_hash as all zeros (0000000000000000000000000000000000000000)
2. Frontend was skipping file content fetch when hash was all zeros
3. Result: empty diff on right side

## Fixes Implemented

### Backend (diffreviewer/internal/handlers/handlers.go)
- Modified HandleDiff to convert toCommit="CURRENT" to empty string
- Modified HandleFileContent to accept path parameter for working directory files

### Backend (diffreviewer/internal/git/diff.go)  
- Modified GetDiff to omit 'to' argument when empty (compares to working dir)
- Modified GetFileContent to read from filesystem when hash is all zeros
- Added imports: os, path/filepath
- Added debug logging throughout

### Frontend (diffreviewer/web/src/services/api.ts)
- Modified fetchFileContent(hash, path?) to accept path parameter
- Removed early return for all-zeros hash
- Now sends path parameter to backend when hash is all zeros

### Frontend (diffreviewer/web/src/components/diff-viewer.ts)
- Updated to always call fetchFileContent even for all-zeros hash
- Passes file path as second parameter
- Uses old_path || path for old_hash, path for new_hash

## Next Steps
1. Run `make build` to rebuild frontend and backend
2. Test with CURRENT option - should see working directory file content
3. Verify debug output shows: "Reading from working directory: ..."
4. Close issue when confirmed working
